_comment_dataloader: 4 unpinned workers x prefetch 2 per rank: pinned loader pages are unreclaimable and share the host pool with the ~200GB FULL_STATE_DICT gather at save time (12/pinned/4 crashed a 14B midtrain with HSA_STATUS_ERROR_OUT_OF_RESOURCES).
_comment_save_total_limit: 2, not 1: the previous checkpoint is rotated out around each new save, so a crash in that window leaves nothing resumable and the run restarts from step 0. Costs ~220GB of disk for the spare generation.
_comment_model_revision: The immutable Hub commit the frontier dataset was built against (DATASET_STATUS.md). Threaded to from_pretrained so the trainer loads that exact snapshot instead of whatever the HF cache holds. Under HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 it must resolve to a local snapshot; a development run whose cache lacks it warns and proceeds unpinned, KORE_MODEL_IDENTITY_MODE=production makes it fatal.
